Is it possible to build a full-time business exclusively on Facebook Marketplace? In this episode, we sit down with Alex Hansen ( https://www.theshelfdude.com ), aka "The Shelf Dude," to find out how he turned a simple DIY garage project into a business netting $15,000 a month.

Alex breaks down exactly how he achieved 70-80% profit margins , why he quit his day job to build shelves full-time, and his strategy for creating infinite free leads. We also discuss his major pivot: how he is now monetizing his competitors by building a nationwide installer network and selling digital plans.

If you are looking for a low-cost side hustle or want to learn how to sell anything on Facebook Marketplace, this episode is a masterclass in execution.
